visualCharacteristics.purpose: feature-by-plan comparison rendered as an accessible table with grouped plan headers and included/optional markers
visualCharacteristics.layout: group header bars spanning their plan columns, plan-name row, feature rows with a left label column; horizontal scroll below ~700px
visualCharacteristics.markers: ● solid dot = included, ○ outlined circle = optional at additional charge (visually-hidden text labels)

contentPattern.structure: every row has the same number of cells (6 in the UE model); row 1: group headers (first cell empty, a group label followed by empty cells for each further column it spans; optional); row 2: plan names (first cell empty); rows 3+: feature label + one value per plan (● included, ○ optional at additional charge, free text such as 10% Off, or empty)

reuseGuidance: Use for tabular feature-by-plan (or feature-by-product) comparisons with ●/○ markers. Legend paragraphs ("● included", "○ optional at additional charge") go as default content directly after the block in the same section.
